author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗೆದ್ದೆನೆನ್ನುತ ಬೀಗೆ ಅವನತಿಯ ಆರಂಭ
ಬಿದ್ದವನು ಛಲದಿಂದ ಸಮಯ ಕಾಯುವನು
ಹದ್ದುಮೀರದೆ ಮನವ ಶುದ್ಧವಿಟ್ಟಿರೆ ನೀನು
ಗೆದ್ದೇತೀರುವೆ ಜಗವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Strutting ‘I have won’ is the beginning of the fall;
the one who fell waits for his time with grit;
if you keep your mind pure, without crossing bounds,
you will surely win the world, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Pride in victory begins our decline; the defeated wait patiently for their turn. Keep your mind pure and within bounds, and lasting success is yours.
